title: The key return
body: A master key lies across a folded departure notice; the hall door was logged locked before the bus left, though a margin says it stood open. The custodian has underlined “return key” twice.
rival_reading: A program crew could have used the hall and its transport during ordinary field work; the contradictory door note does not say why the bus left.
gloss: A hall key and departure record disagree about whether the building was secured before transport left.

title: Before the beds dry
body: The caretaker says the grounds crew borrowed the kitchen sink for a rinse. Please keep the side room locked until the treated beds are dry; the folding chairs are still needed tomorrow.
rival_reading: A response crew could have rinsed equipment and restricted access after an emergency; the note never identifies what treatment reached the grounds.
gloss: A caretaker's request links a grounds crew, rinsed equipment, and a temporary room restriction.
